items.title: Trump says US-Iran deal to be signed on Sunday as Tehran casts doubt on timing
items.description: The US president's comments come as Iran says an exact date has not been decided.

items.title: Swiss voters reject 10 million population cap, early projections say
items.description: Not all votes have been counted, but the current trend suggests 55% of participants voted against the proposal.

items.title: Russian families use AI to 'resurrect' loved ones killed in Ukraine
items.description: The highly controversial trend lies at the intersection of Russia's war on Ukraine, new AI technologies and grief.

items.title: New York Knicks win NBA championship for first time in over 50 years
items.description: The Knicks clinched the title against the San Antonio Spurs, 94-90, in the fifth game of the best-of-seven series.

items.title: Tourist train overturns and injures 17 during Cártama tapas festival
items.description: Nobody was seriously hurt as a result of the accident in the Spanish town, local authorities say.

items.title: Author Chimamanda Adichie accuses hospital of stalling review into son's death
items.description: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's 21-month old son died in a Lagos hospital, which she says is trying to stop an inquest into the circumstances of his death.

items.title: Fifa to pay Somali referee Artan full World Cup fee
items.description: Somali referee Omar Artan, who was denied entry to the United States to officiate at the World Cup, will still receive his tournament fee from Fifa in full.
